entities.summary: Clement Okechukwu Nwankwo is a lawyer and human rights activist in Nigeria. He is the Executive Director of Policy and Legal Advocacy Centre and convener of Civil Society Situation Room (PLAC). He is recognised as the first Nigerian to establish a human rights organisation. Clement Nwankwo was a legal figures from Lagos (b. 1962-05-09, Lagos). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
